bettingFramework.summary: Official sources can certify facts such as fixture, score, tactics, referee, and final status. They cannot certify a future result. The betting-readiness tier combines model edge, official-data completeness, draw pressure, late-goal risk, and lineup freshness so the site can separate stronger leans from high-volatility traps.

tiers.label: No Bet
tiers.use: No clean model edge, source conflict, or the matchup is already closed.

tiers.label: Watch Only
tiers.use: Fixture is confirmed, but official XI/tactics or key match-state inputs are still missing.

tiers.label: Lean
tiers.use: Model edge is present, source quality is usable, and volatility is not extreme.

tiers.label: Strong Lean
tiers.use: Favorite probability is materially ahead, official source coverage is strong, and draw/late-goal risk is contained.

tiers.label: High Volatility
tiers.use: Draw plus opponent share or late-goal risk is high enough that a late swing can erase the favorite edge.

thresholds.strongLean: favorite >= 62, non-favorite <= 38, late-goal <= 55, source gap >= 0.35, official lineup visible
thresholds.lean: favorite >= 54, source gap >= 0.25, non-favorite <= 46, late-goal <= 65, official data usable
thresholds.highVolatility: non-favorite >= 45 or draw pressure >= 55 or late-goal >= 65
thresholds.watchOnly: official lineup/tactics still pending or fact-certainty below 70
